'''Trevin Tyson''' played the [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]], [[2009 Match Play Championship]]. At the [[2008 Delaware State Championship]] on 14 September 2008 the World Championship Day 2 bye passed down to fourth place and was earned by him.<ref name="pcf-22840-336023">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=336023#336023 Official Thread - Delaware States 9/14], Tim Simon (Aglets), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (14 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080915092356/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=335617 Internet Archive]</ref>
